# Version 4.151.0
> **Faster raster and shaping paths** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 restores CPU bitmap-rendering performance and reduces overhead in color and text hot paths. Built on Skia m151, this release adds span-based parsing and .NET 11 WebAssembly archives. It also releases intermediate subset images promptly and corrects GPU stencil tracking.

## Breaking Changes

- **Remove whitespace immediately after the color prefix** — SKColor.Parse/TryParse now reject whitespace directly after # in the six- and eight-digit forms, matching the stricter short forms. Remove that whitespace before parsing; case-insensitive hexadecimal input and surrounding whitespace remain supported. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Engine

- **Skia m151** — Advances the bundled renderer to milestone m151 without changing the C API in the milestone sync. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294))

## API Surface

- **Parse directly from spans** — Adds ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads for SKColor.Parse/TryParse, SKFourByteTag.Parse, and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse so slices can be parsed without allocating substrings. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408))

## Bug Fixes

- **CPU bitmap performance restored** — Restores the legacy shader-context path for scaled and tiled CPU bitmap draws, addressing high CPU usage, frame drops, and flicker in software-rendered views. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))
- **GPU stencil and resolve tracking** — Corrects stencil clear tracking across surface origins and preserved stencil use, and restores dirty tracking for unexecuted resolves. ([#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))
- **Native text-buffer cleanup** — Fixes a use-after-free when corrupt Slug data is rejected during native text-buffer deserialization. ([#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Lower-overhead color math** — Moves SKColor-to-SKColorF and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply math into managed code with native-equivalent results. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **Lower-allocation shaping** — Pooled UTF-8 encoding and zero-copy glyph-result reads reduce shaping allocations. Tag parsing avoids scratch arrays while preserving packing, padding, and truncation semantics. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408))
- **Subset image resources released promptly** — SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) disposes the intermediate full image when Subset returns a different image, while preserving same-instance results. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Platform

- **.NET 11 WebAssembly compatibility** — Ships Emscripten 5.0.6 archives with the new exception-handling model for .NET 11 targets, fixing link and browser startup failures. .NET 8 and .NET 9/10 retain their existing archive mappings. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Buffer.AddUtf8(string) uses pooled encoding, and Tag.Parse adds a span overload while avoiding its scratch array. WebAssembly packages also supply the Emscripten 5.0.6 archive for .NET 11 targets.
